leakage_checks.detail: 84 features; saved reference vectors reproduced exactly.
Estimator pipelines refit imputation/scaling in every outer and inner calibration fold.
Every outcome scored once by a clone trained without its outer test fold.
0 duplicate complete records; grouped patient validation not possible without patient identifiers.
No independent external dataset was supplied.

limitations: Internal single-cohort cross-validation of fixed cloned configurations, not external clinical validation of fitted production weights.
Model configurations were historically developed using this cohort; outer CV does not remove earlier model-selection bias.
Threshold exploration uses these OOF outcomes; choosing a threshold here is exploratory, not an unbiased clinical operating-point validation.
SHAP and feature stability, when present, explain the independent XGBoost comparator, not the deployed calibrated configuration; TreeSHAP units are raw log-odds.
Permutation importance perturbs engineered columns independently. Correlated and derived features may split importance or produce implausible combinations.
Fold dispersion is descriptive, not a confidence interval. Small reliability-bin counts have substantial sampling uncertainty.
Original model training timestamp and historical selection decision log were not supplied. The evaluated configuration is identified by its saved artifact hash.
Derived clinical proxies and reference artery territories are model assumptions, not patient-specific imaging or validated clinical scores.
Stacking was not implemented; no stacking results are fabricated. Additional SVM and Decision Tree configurations are experimental comparators.
Repeatability targets metric agreement to absolute tolerance 1e-8 under archived source and pinned dependencies; different hardware/library versions can change floating-point results.

provenance.evaluation_method: Fixed deployed per-target recipes and saved thresholds; refitted outer OOF, not nested selection-strategy evaluation
provenance.preprocessing: Fixed category normalization and row-local clinical engineering; training-only measurement medians/category modes; saved ordered float32 feature contract. Scaling/calibration inside estimator pipelines.

limitations: Internal single-cohort evaluation, not external clinical validation.
Earlier configurations were developed on this cohort; historical selection bias remains.
Outer metrics evaluate the selection procedure, not the final full-cohort fitted weights.
Promotion is chosen after seeing outer metrics; release-level selection adds optimism. Gains are descriptive and not evidence of statistical significance.
Final configuration and threshold are selected on full-cohort inner OOF data, not on outer-test predictions.
Independent XGBoost SHAP explanations remain surrogate attributions, not exact explanations of the calibrated predictor.
Clinical proxies and RWMA territory assumptions are preserved for compatibility. Recorded-feature ablations are available in the broad search; the RCA shortlist uses full features.
The RCA shortlist follows an unsuccessful broader tuning trial on this same cohort. This additional experiment increases historical selection bias.
Classification thresholds are separate from the 35%/65% artery display bands.
evaluation.method: Paired stratified 10-fold outer evaluation; 3-fold inner model/threshold selection for RCA; sigmoid calibration within each estimator fit. Other targets retain their current configuration and threshold.
